signals.raise: USD 100M Series C at USD 1.4bn valuation (Apr 2026; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slash_(company))

name: Slash
desc: Slash Financial runs an online business banking platform offering cards, payments and financial services to small and mid-sized businesses.
capacity_detail: Valued at USD 1.4bn after USD 100M Series C led by Ribbit Capital, April 2026
markets: United States small and mid-sized businesses, including performance marketing firms, HVAC operators and crypto-native businesses
rationale: Fast-growing fintech competing for business customers; F1 B2B hospitality and visibility could build trust beside rivals like Amex and Revolut.

signals.raise: USD 55M at USD 1.25bn valuation led by IVP (Oct 2026; https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/29/wabi-the-ai-agent-that-builds-mini-apps-now-valued-at-1-25b-after-latest-round/)

name: Wabi
desc: Wabi is a consumer AI personal agent app that builds mini apps for tasks like meal planning and fitness.
capacity_detail: Valued at USD 1.25bn after USD 55M round led by IVP, October 2026
markets: Consumer app users; the article states no specific markets beyond the app's launch to the public
rationale: Consumer AI app needing mass brand awareness; F1's young global fanbase suits a newly funded challenger to larger AI assistants.

signals.raise: USD 60M Series B at USD 1bn valuation (Jan 2026; https://www.aikido.dev/blog/aikido-funding-series-b)

name: Aikido Security
desc: Aikido Security develops application security software covering code scanning, dependency analysis, cloud security and runtime protection.
capacity_detail: USD 60M Series B at USD 1bn valuation led by DST Global, January 2026
markets: Over 100,000 teams globally; offices in Ghent, San Francisco, London and Chicago
rationale: Cybersecurity rivals such as CrowdStrike, Zscaler and Bitdefender use F1; a European challenger could gain developer and CISO reach.

name: Substrate
desc: Substrate is developing X-ray lithography machines to rival ASML and plans to make advanced processors in the US.
capacity_detail: Initial USD 100M raise at USD 1bn valuation from Founders Fund, General Catalyst and others, October 2025
markets: United States semiconductor supply chain; no processors delivered yet, first ones expected in about three years
rationale: Deep-tech chip challenger could use F1's engineering prestige for recruitment and investor profile, though pre-revenue limits budget.

signals.raise: USD 66M Series C at USD 1bn valuation (Oct 2026; https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/21/blacksmith-hits-unicorn-valuation-after-sequoia-leads-series-c/)

name: Blacksmith
desc: Blacksmith provides a platform that helps companies build and test software faster, including AI-written code.
capacity_detail: USD 66M Series C at USD 1bn valuation led by Sequoia, October 2026; USD 125M raised to date
markets: Software engineering teams; named customers include Mercury and Granola; over 90 million CI jobs run
rationale: Developer-tools peers like Vercel, Atlassian and Dropbox sponsor F1; performance-engineering story fits a fast CI platform.

signals.raise: USD 60M Series B at USD 1bn valuation (Oct 2026; https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/23/agent-cloud-startup-daytona-hits-1b-valuation-backed-by-firstmark-and-a-whos-who-of-angels/)

name: Daytona
desc: Daytona runs a cloud giving AI agents sandboxed Linux, Windows, macOS and GPU computing environments on one platform.
capacity_detail: USD 60M Series B at USD 1bn valuation led by FirstMark Growth, October 2026; USD 91M raised in total
markets: Developers and companies running long-lived AI agents; the article gives no country breakdown
rationale: AI infrastructure rivals CoreWeave, Groq and Vercel are F1 partners; Daytona could reach enterprise AI buyers the same way.
theme: AI infrastructure: data centres & GPU cloud

signals.raise: Valued at USD 1bn in new funding (May 2026; https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-05-20/security-firm-thwarting-nation-state-hackers-valued-at-1-billion)

name: Socket
desc: Socket provides security software that protects organisations against malicious open-source packages and software supply chain attacks.
capacity_detail: Valued at USD 1bn, May 2026 (Bloomberg, as cited by Wikipedia's unicorn list)
markets: Organisations in technology, media, healthcare and finance; backed by Thrive Capital, a16z and Capital One Ventures
rationale: Security brands CrowdStrike, Zscaler, 1Password and Keeper already use F1 to reach CISOs; Socket could follow at smaller scale.

name: Epassi
desc: Epassi runs a digital employee benefits platform connecting employers, employees and over 100,000 merchants such as gyms and restaurants.
ownership: private equity: TA Associates and Warburg Pincus
capacity_detail: USD 1bn deal to buy Exercite, December 2023 (Bloomberg, as cited by Wikipedia's unicorn list)
markets: Nine European markets: Finland, Sweden, Italy, Germany, Netherlands, UK and Ireland, Spain, Portugal and Poland; 36 million users
rationale: Pan-European benefits brand with sport and wellness merchants; F1 hospitality could win HR buyers as it expands across Europe.

name: Diffusely (formerly Meero)
desc: Diffusely, formerly Meero, sells AI-based SaaS tools for creating, enhancing and distributing visual content at scale.
capacity_detail: USD 300M raised in total, including USD 230M round in June 2019
markets: Businesses in fashion and automotive among others, via Autoretouch (Germany) and Carcutter (Austria) acquisitions; HQ Paris
rationale: Automotive imaging software via Carcutter gives a car-industry link, but a shrunk, pivoted company is a weak F1 prospect.

name: WeLab
desc: WeLab is a Hong Kong fintech group running online consumer lending and WeLab Bank, a licensed virtual bank.
capacity_detail: Total funding over USD 580M after USD 156M Series C (2019), plus USD 75M Series C1 from Allianz X (2021)
markets: Hong Kong, mainland China and Indonesia; over 40 million customers as of 2020
rationale: Asian digital bank brand competing with Revolut and Nu, both F1 partners; Singapore or Shanghai races could build regional awareness.

name: Dubizzle Group (formerly EMPG)
desc: Dubizzle Group runs online classifieds and property portals including Dubizzle, Bayut and Hatla2ee across the Middle East.
capacity_detail: USD 150M raised in 2020 alongside OLX MENA merger + USD 200M Series E led by Affinity Partners in 2022
markets: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Oman, Bahrain, Qatar, Jordan and Kuwait; over 2,600 staff across 10 countries
rationale: Gulf consumer brand with property and car verticals; Abu Dhabi, Saudi, Qatar and Bahrain Grands Prix match its markets.

name: Voi
desc: Voi Technology rents shared electric scooters and e-bikes through its own app in over 100 European cities.
capacity_detail: USD 136M raised to Nov 2019 (incl. USD 85M Series B) + USD 115M round in 2021 (sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voi_Technology)
markets: Over 100 cities across Europe, including city licences in London, Milan and Marseille
rationale: Urban electric mobility brand could tie into F1's sustainability and city-race narratives, though budgets are modest.
